evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~6 ppm to 44.7 ppm instead of staying at purge-level baseline
O2 began climbing at growth onset (12 -> 20 -> 29 -> 34 -> 45 ppm)
Temperature holds at 750 °C and Ar flow steady at 100 sccm; no control fault evident
Pressure gauge not installed, so leak/atmosphere integrity cannot be confirmed independently

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) to confirm a leak vs. outgassing; continued O2 trend and post-run sample characterization
